prompt: Out of all of Steven Spielberg's Oscar winning movies up until 2020, which one has made the most money?
answer:
**_Jurassic Park_ (1993)** made the most money among Steven Spielberg’s Oscar-winning films up to 2020. It won **three Academy Awards** and grossed roughly **$1.1 billion worldwide**, including re-releases.

If you mean films for which **Spielberg personally won an Oscar**, then **_Saving Private Ryan_** was the higher-grossing one, at about **$482 million worldwide**.
